description: Analyze a token's risk profile. EVM: checks contract verification, proxy status, ownership renouncement, liquidity. Solana: checks mint/freeze authority, supply, Metaplex metadata. Scope: asset-level token due diligence for a token contract or mint, combining market, liquidity, verification, and control signals. Use this when the question is 'is this token safe or liquid?'. It is not raw bytecode inspection (use security.contract.scan), a wallet's financial behavior (use wallet.credit_score), or a multi-signal address dashboard (use analyze.risk_dashboard).

address.description: Token contract address (EVM hex) or mint address (Solana base58)

chain.description: Blockchain to query. EVM chains: base, ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bsc, avalanche, zksync, linea, scroll, blast, mantle, gnosis, polygon-zkevm, mode, sei, celo, manta, taiko, fantom, cronos, opbnb, zora, worldchain, metis, fraxtal, kava, zetachain, filecoin, core-dao, aurora, moonbeam, klaytn, bob, canto, monad, tempo, megaeth, arc, plasma, katana, robinhood, pharos, hyperevm. Dedicated non-EVM adapters: solana, hyperliquid, canton.
